'''Dak Linser''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Wilhalm Skrim]] tasked an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] operative with [[Death/Legends|killing]] Linser and two other Rebel scouts.<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RebelScoutTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Dak Linser]]
Dak Linser was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" />
